snippet.title: Gin Rummy gameplay trailer: free two-player Gin Rummy in your browser
snippet.description:
Gin Rummy is a two-player card game played in hands, first to 100 points. Each turn you draw from the stock or discard pile and throw one card. Arrange ten cards into runs and sets, and knock when your deadwood is 10 or less. Free in the browser, with a lesson, a solo ladder and a daily challenge.

▶ Play free: https://nowplay.gg/games/gin-rummy
☀ Daily challenge, the same for every player: https://nowplay.gg/play/gin-rummy/daily
